utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Dane — that should get us set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to help — just let me know if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do, Dane — I’ll keep an eye on the remaining supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll come Sunday at the community center and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — that really helps. When you get there Sunday, I’ll point you straight to the most urgent repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I’ll be there Sunday and ready to help with whatever’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, it’s on — go ahead and tell people. I’ll keep you posted as folks reach out and let me know what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm, you’ll keep me posted if anyone reaches out and what they can bring, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, absolutely — I’ll keep you posted on who reaches out and what they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — keep me posted if anything else comes up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep tracking what’s left for the repair drive. Let me know if you still need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — thanks, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday at 9 at the community center works for me. I can bring the screwdriver set and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Sunday at 9 at the community center works. Please bring the screwdriver set and gloves, and keep it quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’ll keep it quiet and bring both.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — the biggest needs are still the leaky faucet, loose porch rail, and the broken window. If you can help sort volunteers by skill, I’ll keep the list organized for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll sort the volunteers by skill for those three repairs so we can stay on track for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — I’ll keep the repair list updated and make sure everyone knows to meet Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good, Gus — I’ll see you at 9:30 Saturday after the school run.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — 9:30 Saturday after the school run works for me. I’ll bring the tools and be ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — that’ll be perfect for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll spread the word and send the details out soon. See you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll keep spreading the word and send out the details soon!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks — I just want to make sure the timing and bring-list are clear before the repair drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still planning to bring my tools by the repair drive and help where they need it most. I’ll check the timing and bring-list first so we’re both clear.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that should make it easier to keep things straight. Send the timing and bring-list when you can, and I’ll double-check everything before we start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — what time is the repair drive, and do we still need hands, tools, or any spare supplies?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It starts at 10 a.m. tomorrow, and we still need extra hands, a few basic tools, and any spare screws or tape you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll come at 10 a.m. tomorrow and bring a few tools plus any spare screws or tape I can find.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, and spare screws. If I hear of any extras, I’ll bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Nell — appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll keep listening around and let you know if I hear of anything else we might need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ve been mentioning it around town, and a few folks said they might be able to help. I’ll keep an eye out for more tools and supplies while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira—that really helps a lot. I appreciate you keeping the word going for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll keep spreading the word and flag anyone who’s willing to pitch in. I’ll let you know if I hear about more tools or supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Any update on the latest tally for Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m still checking the latest tally, Mina—sorry, my notes are a bit mixed up. I’ll get you the current number for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren. I’ll wait for the latest tally.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m a bit late—what’s left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We still need to sort the tools, label the donation boxes, and set out the sign-in sheet. If you can grab the tape and markers, we’ll be right on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll grab the tape and markers right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: We’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center. I’m a bit forgetful, so a quick reminder later would really help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it — Sunday at the community center. I’ll send a quick reminder later, and I’m checking the timing and bring-list so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Pia — that’ll help a lot. If you spot anything I should bring, just let me know and I’ll keep it on my list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, quick update, Uli — the repair drive’s now on Sunday at the community center. I’ll let you know if anything changes again.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. Sunday at the community center works better for me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Glad to hear it, Uli — I’ll pass along any more updates if they come up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’m ready for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll wait for Opal’s confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — that’s right, Sunday at the community center. I’ll let you know as soon as Opal confirms.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Noah — I’ll keep Sunday at the community center open and wait for Opal’s confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, Mara — I’ll take a look as soon as it comes through.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — I’ll send over the updated details and sign-up list soon for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks Mara — I’ll review it when it arrives.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check in on the repair drive and let you know what they need most first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll wait for your update and go from there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check in and keep you posted on what they need most first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: You’re welcome, Quinn — I’ll keep an eye on the next stop and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks, Opal — I’ll tell everyone the repair drive is on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll keep tracking the next stops and share any new updates right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll be there Sunday around 9 at the community center and help get everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh perfect, Sunday at the community center at 9 works great—thanks for updating that. I’ll keep everyone posted and see you there!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Tess — happy to help, and I’ll see you Sunday at 9 at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still on, right? I’ll wait for the details.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still on. I’ll send the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye — I’ll keep an eye out and be ready right around pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll send the note after the school run and we can head out for the repair drive right after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye — I’ll be ready right after pickup and watch for your note.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll check the drill battery tonight and let you know once I hear the repair drive time and what supplies are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — please let me know the repair drive time and the remaining supplies once you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Hana — I’ll check tonight and get back to you as soon as I know the time and what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh good — so it’s Sunday at the community center now, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, that’s right — Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks for confirming — I’ll head there Sunday at the community center.
